\"G, don't head straight through, go aro: "G, don't head straight through, go around.  There's a glowing one just hanging out in the alley.  I tried stabbing it but it zapped me with some sort of static electricity and I ran back here.  I'll try to whack it with a club next time."
\"G, if you find this, I'm at the farm j: "G, if you find this, I'm at the farm just out of town.  I'll need to stay there a few days, I've been wounded by one of those overgrown bastards, shot a spike right into my thigh.  I'll wait for you there as long as I can, stay safe."
\"G, the city is full of them. I don't: "G, the city is full of them.  I don't know how, it's as if we never came through here.  They're the same ones we'd put down, I am sure of it.  They got back up and now look more dangerous than ever.  I saw one of them just snatch a bird right off the roof with its long hands.  You have to use the sewers.  I know we agreed not to travel underground, but as horrible as it is down there, I fear our world up here is no longer ours either."
\"G, I have not found any of your notes,: "G, I have not found any of your notes, which means you're either taking a different path or have already made your way back home.  In the case you're still out here somewhere, if you see the sky suddenly grow dark, hide indoors immediately, I have a feeling this storm is far from over."
\"G, be careful around those bulging and: "G, be careful around those bulging and pulsating corpses.  I saw one today.  I think there's something eating away at those things.  I didn't stick around to find out.  I burnt the entire building down, just to be sure, so you should have relatively safe passage."
\"G, I ran into an actual human today!: "G, I ran into an actual human today!  He was looking for his daughter.  We exchanged some food and traded information on the surrounding area.  He spoke of a family living on a farm out in the fields, surviving and thriving!  Maybe it's time we carved ourselves a peaceful place in this hell.  We'll discuss this once we meet back home."
\"G, there's something not right with th: "G, there's something not right with the forests here.  The ground there feels soft and is overgrown with some sort of mushrooms.  Be careful not to breathe in the dust they kick up, I accidentally took a whiff and have been coughing and vomiting since.  The map shows there's a cabin just outside town, I'll lay low there until I feel better.  I'm almost home.  I know you will be waiting for me there."
\"I saw a zombie covered in shrooms emit: "I saw a zombie covered in shrooms emitting some strange dust.  When another zombie got close, the two tore each other apart.  I'd rather not stay here anymore.  Im packing up my stuff soon."
\"I can see a large tower in the distanc: "I can see a large tower in the distance, And strange stalk-like creatures are around it.  I feel sick just looking at it, and fire hasn't solved it.  Those things seem to stay around it though."
\"These berries are delicious! Maybe ta: "These berries are delicious!  Maybe taking these were worth it.  And the more I eat, the more of it appears!  it's like an infinite food cycle!"
\"I found a corpse with strange berries: "I found a corpse with strange berries shoved down their gullet, seems to have choked to death on the stuff.  greedy bastard"
\"Don't trust them. The mushrooms aren': "Don't trust them.  The mushrooms aren't your friends.  They're delusional"
The bark of this \"plant\" has a bark li: The bark of this "plant" has a bark like texture, but is more leathery in consistency.
The smell emanating from the creature wh: The smell emanating from the creature when you dissect it reminds you of vegetables.
The monster's sap is sticky and somewhat: The monster's sap is sticky and somewhat greenish.
Thick fibers are found throughout the bo: Thick fibers are found throughout the body of the creature.  Perhaps they serve a scaffolding purpose similar to that of (very flexible) bones.
The creature's whip like sting drips fro: The creature's whip like sting drips from poison.  You take extra care not to accidentally scratch yourself on it.
The creature appears to have a vascular: The creature appears to have a vascular system vaguely similar to those of animals, with a branching network of vein, although the organization is unfamiliar.
You find what you think is a heart, alth: You find what you think is a heart, although it doesn't look like any configuration you know of from Earth.  In fact, you find four hearts, each seemingly supporting a lateral quarter of the body.
While the roots of the plant creature co: While the roots of the plant creature contain muscles and veins, they also contain finer networks indicating a use for nutrient uptake when the roots are lodged into the soil.
At the top of the creature you find what: At the top of the creature you find what you assume is a brain, although it seems to employ quadrilateral symmetry and thus is shaped and organized completely differently from that of terrestrial versions.
Welcome to the Cataclysm tutorial! As y:
Ti diamo il benvenuto nel tutorial di Cataclysm!  Mentre giochi, delle schermate come questa compariranno per spiegarti le azioni base del gioco.

Puoi premere <keybind:HELP_KEYBINDINGS> in qualsiasi momento per aprire il <color_light_cyan>Menù dei controlli</color> per vedere o modificare i comandi del gioco, sia generici che specifici per i vari menù aperti al momento.

Premi <keybind:POPUP_WAIT:QUIT> per chiudere il messaggio.
The character in the center of the scree:
Il personaggio al centro dello schermo sei tu.  Secondo le impostazioni predefinite, il movimento viene eseguito usando il <color_yellow>tastierino numerico</color>, i tasti <color_yellow>hjklyubn</color>, o le <color_yellow>frecce direzionali</color>.

Controlli di Movimento:
Nord: <keybind:UP>
Sud: <keybind:DOWN>
Ovest: <keybind:LEFT>
Est: <keybind:RIGHT>
Nordovest: <keybind:LEFTUP>
Nordest: <keybind:RIGHTUP>
Sudovest: <keybind:LEFTDOWN>
Sudest: <keybind:RIGHTDOWN>
Aspetta sul posto: <keybind:pause>

Puoi anche usare <keybind:SELECT> per selezionare il luogo in cui muoverti, e premerlo un'altra volta per confermare il movimento.

Per continuare il tutorial, muoviti verso la porta ad est.
Most of the time your character will be:
Per la maggior parte del tempo il tuo personaggio si muoverà in modalità camminata.  Ma qualche volta è utile cambiarla.

Ci sono quattro modalità di movimento in gioco:
<color_light_cyan>Camminata</color>: è la modalità predefinita; la velocità di movimento, il consumo di stamina ed il rumore sono moderati
<color_light_cyan>Corsa</color>: il tuo personaggio si <color_light_green>muoverà molto più velocemente</color>, ma la tua <color_light_red>stamina si consumerà rapidamente</color>
<color_light_cyan>Accovacciato</color>: il tuo personaggio sarà <color_light_green>meno visibile ai mostri</color> consentendoti di nasconderti dietro gli ostacoli, <color_light_red>diminuendo la velocità di movimento</color> ed il <color_light_green>rumore</color>
<color_light_cyan>Prono</color>: <color_light_green>sei ancora meno visibile</color> ai mostri, la <color_light_red>velocità di movimento è ridotta ulteriormente</color>, così come il <color_light_green>rumore</color>.

Premendo <keybind:open_movement> aprirai il menù della <color_light_cyan>Modalità di Movimento</color>, il quale ti permetterà di cambiare la tua andatura in qualsiasi momento.  Per praticità, è possibile assegnare dei tasti aggiuntivi per passare a modalità di movimento specifiche.

Per continuare il tutorial, percorri il corridoio.
You can also use the mouse to see things: Puoi usare il mouse per esaminare l'ambiente circostante.  La finestra di <color_light_cyan>visuale del Mouse</color> apparirà a lato, e avrai informazioni sul terreno, i mostri e gli oggetti presenti.  In alternativa, puoi premere <keybind:look> per aprire la finestra di <color_light_cyan>Scrutamento</color>.
Ti trovi accanto ad una porta chiusa.  Per aprirla, camminaci verso, oppure premi <keybind:open> e poi scegli una direzione usando un tasto di movimento.  Usando <keybind:open> potrai aprire non solo porte, ma anche finestre, cancelli, recinti, casseforti, e così via.
You can close an opened door by pressing: Puoi chiudere una porta aperta premendo <keybind:close> e poi scegliendo una direzione.  Chiudere le porte dietro di te può spesso rallentare efficacemente folle di mostri.
Most monsters will have to smash their w: La maggior parte dei mostri deve sfondare una porta chiusa per poterla attraversare.  Se una porta è chiusa a chiave o parzialmente rotta, puoi frantumarla premendo <keybind:smash> e poi scegliendo una direzione.
You can smash through windows by pressin: Puoi frantumare le finestre premendo <keybind:smash> e poi scegliendo una direzione.  Attraversare una finestra sfondata richiede molto tempo, ed è possibile che ti ferisca sui vetri rotti, ma è una buona via di fuga estrema.  Frantumando ancora una finestra rotta potrai rimuovere i frammenti di vetro, permettendoti di passarci attraverso in tutta sicurezza, sebbene ti richiederà comunque un po' di tempo.  Quasi tutto può essere frantumato, presupponendo che tu abbia abbastanza forza o che tu stia infliggendo abbastanza danni.
You just stepped on a space with one or:
Ora ti trovi su uno spazio con uno o più oggetti.  Se desideri raccoglierlo, premi <keybind:pickup>.  Per selezionare il quadrato direttamente sotto di te, premi <keybind:pause>.

Nel menù di <color_light_cyan>Raccolta</color> premi:
<keybind:RIGHT> per selezionare gli oggetti che vuoi raccogliere
<keybind:LEFT> per deselezionare
<keybind:CONFIRM> per confermare

Ricordati che non è necessario che tu ti trovi direttamente sullo spazio con gli oggetti da raccogliere, puoi raccoglierli anche standoci vicino.

Se l'oggetto non entra nelle tue tasche, o è un'arma che vuoi impugnare, puoi premere <keybind:wield> per prenderlo dal pavimento o dal menù di <color_light_cyan>Raccolta</color>.

Per continuare il tutorial, raccogli la <color_light_cyan>mazza da baseball</color> su cui ti trovi e dirigiti verso la porta a sud.
There is a display rack next to you with:
Accanto a te c'è uno scaffale, su cui è poggiata una lancia d'acciaio.  Puoi premere <keybind:wield> per impugnare direttamente un oggetto, senza prima doverlo raccogliere.  Premendo <keybind:wield> si aprirà il menù <color_light_cyan>Impugna Oggetto</color>.  Seleziona l'oggetto che vuoi impugnare e conferma premendo <keybind:CONFIRM>.

Siccome non hai spazio libero nell'inventario, per impugnare la lancia devi lasciare la <color_light_cyan>mazza da baseball</color> per terra.

Se desideri avere le mani libere (cioè non impugnare niente), premi <keybind:wield> e seleziona l'oggetto che stai impugnando al momento.  In alternativa, puoi lasciare a terra l'oggetto impugnato al momento premendo <keybind:drop> e selezionandolo.

Per continuare il tutorial, impugna la lancia e dirigiti verso i banconi ad ovest.
There is a <color_light_cyan>water dispe: Dietro l'angolo c'è un <color_light_cyan>distributore d'acqua</color>.  Raccogli la <color_light_cyan>bottiglia di plastica</color> dallo scaffale e vai al distributore.
The item you just picked up is a type of: L'oggetto che hai appena raccolto è un capo d'abbigliamento!  Per indossare i vestiti, premi <keybind:wear> e seleziona quello che ti interessa.  Se vuoi toglierti un abito, premi <keybind:take_off>, oppure premi <keybind:drop> per toglierlo e gettarlo a terra con una singola azione.
The item you just picked up is a good we: L'oggetto che hai appena raccolto è un'arma!  Per impugnarla, premi <keybind:wield> e seleziona l'oggetto da impugnare.  Per non impugnare niente, getta la tua arma a terra premendo <keybind:drop>, o premi <keybind:wield> per metterla via.  Uno zombie è comparso nelle vicinanze.  Per attaccarlo, muoviti verso di lui.
The item you just picked up is a comesti: L'oggetto che hai raccolto è commestibile!  Per mangiarlo, premi <keybind:eat>.  Tali oggetti sono consumabili, come cibo, bibite, medicinali, ecc.  La maggior parte del cibo ha una data di scadenza, per cui fa attenzione.  Alcuni consumabili, specialmente i farmaci, possono avere dei subdoli effetti a lungo termine.
The item you just picked up is a tool!: L'oggetto che hai appena raccolto è uno strumento!  Per attivarlo, premi <keybind:apply>.  Alcuni strumenti hanno una carica definita, che può essere ricaricata una volta esaurita.  Altri sono oggetti ad uso singolo, e altri ancora sono riutilizzabili.
The item you just picked up is a firearm: L'oggetto che hai raccolto è un'arma da fuoco!  Queste sono armi molto potenti, ma richiedono munizioni.  Le armi da fuoco hanno molti attributi speciali.  La maggior parte modifica i danni inflitti dalle loro munizioni.  Inoltre hanno un valore di dispersione, che influenza la probabilità di colpire.  Alcune armi sono semi automatiche, mentre altre possono essere sparate a raffica.  Alcune armi a distanza (soprattutto archi ed altre armi che richiedono forza) hanno una gittata, che viene sommata alla gittata del proiettile usato.
The item you just picked up is ammunitio: Hai appena raccolto dei proiettili, da usare con una pistola.  Anche i proiettili hanno delle statistiche, il danno indica la quantità massima che si può infliggere con un colpo normale; un colpo critico o alla testa farà molti più danni.  Alcuni mostri o NPC indosseranno armature che riducono i danni dalle armi da fuoco, i proiettili perforanti sono utili in queste circostanze.  La gittata è la distanza massima che un proiettile può raggiungere, mentre la dispersione ne modifiche la probabilità di colpire.
You just put on an article of clothing t: Hai appena indossato un indumento che fornisce protezione fisica.  Ci sono tre tipi di danno contro cui gli abiti possono proteggere: <color_light_cyan>impatto</color>, <color_light_cyan>taglio</color> e <color_light_cyan>balistico</color>.  La maggior parte dei mostri infligge danni da impatto, ma quelli da taglio sono spesso i più letali.  Non molti nemici infliggono danni balistici, tra di loro ci sono alcuni robot, torrette e personaggi non giocanti (NPC).

Hai appena indossato un indumento che fornisce molto spazio di trasporto.  Questo ti permette di trasportare molte più cose, ma ricordati che anche il peso che puoi trasportare ha un limite, che dipende dalla forza del personaggio.  L'oggetto che hai indossato ti sta anche ingombrando il torso.  Questo renderà il combattimento un po' più difficile. Per controllare l'ingombro, premi <keybind:player_data>.

Per contiunare il tutorial, attraversa il corridoio a nord e indossa tutti gli abiti che trovi sugli scaffali.

Hai appena indossato un indumento che ti protegge contro l'ambiente.  I più comuni ed importanti sono i dispositivi respiratori, i quali ti proteggono contro il fumo, tossine o organismi portati dall'aria, e altri pericoli comuni.  D'altro canto, rendono un po' più difficile respirare quando corri, per cui ti muoverai più lentamente.  Per controllare l'ingombro, premi <keybind:player_data>.
If you press <keybind:inventory> and the: Se premi <keybind:inventory> e poi la lettera associata alla tua arma, vedrai le sue statistiche di combattimento.  Il danno da impatto ignora la maggior parte delle armature, ma il danno inflitto può variare di molto e richiede forza fisica.  Il danno da taglio viene inflitto in quantità fisse, ma viene bloccato dalle armature.  Il bonus per colpire influenza le tue probabilità di mettere a segno il colpo.  Il tempo impiegato per brandire la tua arma da mischia dipende sia dalle sue dimensioni che dal suo peso; le armi piccole e compatte sono le più veloci.
Hitting a monster will stun it briefly,: Colpire un mostro lo stordirà per un breve periodo di tempo, permettendoti di scappare o eseguire un secondo attacco.  La tua destrezza ed abilità in mischia sono usate per determinare se il tuo colpo andrà a segno, mentre la Forza influenza i danni.
Looks like you suddenly felt pain. The:
A quanto pare stai provando dolore.  Lo status del dolore è indicato nella barra a lato e anche nel menù <keybind:player_data>.

Bassi livelli di dolore sono tollerabili, ma se peggiora, le tue statistiche caleranno e ti muoverai più lentamente.  Per ridurre il dolore, prendi un antidolorifico come la <color_light_cyan>codeina</color> sullo scaffale vicino (attivandola con <keybind:apply>), o semplicemente aspetti che passi.
When you kill a monster it will often le: Quando uccidi un mostro, questo lascerà un cadavere.  I corpi sono un'importante fonte di cibo, ma lo devi prima macellare posizionandoti sopra e premendo<keybind:butcher>.  Avrai bisogno di un'arma munita di lama nel tuo inventario, preferibilmente una piccola e molto affilata.  Un macellaio inesperto è in grado di recuperare solo pochi pezzi di carne, se riesce a recuperare qualcosa.  Ricordati che molti mostri, come gli zombie, lasciano carne contaminata, la quale è inadatta al consumo.
That drug you just took is a <color_ligh:
Il farmaco che hai appena preso è un <color_light_cyan>antidolorifico</color>.  Siccome il dolore diminuisce sia le tue statistiche che la tua velocità, gli antidolorifici sono molto importanti e dovrebbero essere tenuti a portata di mano.  Attenzione: gli antidolorifici più forti possono renderti un po' brillo, e alcuni danno addirittura dipendenza.

Tieni a mente che gli antidolorifici non hanno effetto nel momento in cui li assumi.  Hanno bisogno di un po' di tempo perché funzionino e non è necessario prendere un'altra dose se non vedi effetti immediati.  Aspetta e, prima o poi, il dolore comincerà ad andare via.
That drug you just took placed an effect: Il farmaco che hai appena assunto ha avuto effetto su di te.  Puoi controllare i tuoi effetti premendo <keybind:player_data>.  La maggior parte dura solo per poco tempo, mentre altri, come le malattie croniche, durano finché non vengono curati con altri metodi.
You just drank a bottle of water, reduci: Hai appena bevuto una bottiglia di acqua, soddisfacendo la tua sete e riducendo la quantità dell'acqua nella bottiglia.  Devi decidere se buttare via il contenitore per fare spazio nel tuo inventario, o se vuoi tenerli per riempirli d'acqua (o di qualsiasi altro liquido).
You just activated a grenade! You proba: Hai appena attivato una granata!  Credo che tirarla sia una buona idea.  Per lanciare un oggetto, premi <keybind:throw> per poi selezionare l'oggetto che vuoi lanciare.  La distanza massima dipende dalla tua forza e dalle dimensioni e peso dell'oggetto.  Lanciare non è una buona tattica in molte situazioni, ma se riesci a mettere mano su delle molotov…
This thing here on the floor is a <color: Questa cosa qui per terra è una <color_light_cyan>trappola</color>.  Le trappole sono permanenti finché non scattano o vengono disattivate, e possono essere una tattica difensiva importante, soprattutto quando dormi in un territorio poco sicuro.  Prova a camminare sul pluriball.  Non ti preoccupare, è innocuo, ma farà un po' di rumore.  Ci sono altri tipi di trappole in grado di infliggere varie quantità di danno o addirittura di teletrasportarti, perciò fai attenzione a dove metti i piedi.
In the next room you'll find a row of ra:
Nella prossima stanza troverai una fila di scaffali con una pistola, un caricatore per l'arma, e munizioni per il caricatore.  Per poter sparare con una pistola, dovrai inserire un caricatore carico di colpi.  Premi <keybind:reload_item> per aprire il menù di <color_light_cyan>Ricarica Oggetto</color> e inserisci le munizioni nel caricatore, poi premi <keybind:reload_item> un'altra volta per mettere il caricatore nell'arma.

Se desideri scaricare la tua pistola, magari per cambiare il tipo di munizioni, premi <keybind:unload>.
Finally, to fire a gun, press <keybind:f:
Infine, per sparare con la pistola, premi <keybind:fire>.  Punterai automaticamente l'ultimo mostro a cui hai sparato, o quello più vicino.  Puoi cambiare il tuo bersaglio con i <color_yellow>tasti di movimento</color>, o scorri tra i mostri con <keybind:TARGET:PREV_TARGET> e <keybind:TARGET:NEXT_TARGET>.  Seleziona il <color_light_cyan>manichino</color> come bersaglio e premi <keybind:fire> per sparare un singolo colpo.  Con molti tipi di pistole, puoi cambiare la modalità di fuoco in raffica o fuoco automatico premendo <keybind:select_fire_mode>.

Ci sono istruzioni dettagliate su come mirare e fare fuoco nel menù di <color_light_cyan>Puntamento e sparo</color>, assicurati di controllarlo accuratamente.

Per continuare il tutorial, spara un paio di volte al manichino e percorri il corridoio ad ovest.
Firing your gun will increase your recoi: Sparare con la pistola aumenta il livello di rinculo.  Lo puoi vedere nel menù di <color_light_cyan>Puntamento e sparo</color> (premendo <keybind:fire>).  Generalmente parlando, più danni infligge il colpo, più forte sarà il rinculo.  Il suo effetto è di ridurre seriamente la tua probabilità di colpire, ma puoi eliminarlo rimanendo fermo per un turno (<keybind:pause>).  Un'alta forza riduce il rinculo, perciò ai personaggi più deboli conviene usare pistole calibro .22 o 9x19mm.
This is a staircase leading down. To go: Questa è una scalinata che porta al piano inferiore.  Per scendere, posizionati sopra la scala e premi il tasto <keybind:LEVEL_DOWN>.  Analogamente, per salire, posizionati su una scala che sale e premi il tasto <keybind:LEVEL_UP>.
It's dark down here! Without a source o: È buio qui sotto!  Senza una fonte di luce, puoi vedere solo un quadrato in ogni direzione.  Potresti trovarti al buio nel sottosuolo o nelle notti senza luna.  Premi <keybind:LEVEL_UP> per tornare di sopra e cerca una torcia.
It's dark down here! Fortunately, you h: È buio qui sotto!  Per fortuna hai una <color_light_cyan>torcia elettrica</color>.  Premi <keybind:apply> e poi seleziona la tua torcia per accenderla.
From a water source like this, you can f:
Da una fonte d'acqua come questa, puoi riempire qualsiasi contenitore che potresti avere.  Esamina il distributore <keybind:examine> e premi <color_yellow>'c'</color> per riempire un contenitore, poi seleziona la <color_light_cyan>bottiglia di plastica</color> per metterci dell'acqua dentro.

Il comando Esamina (<keybind:examine>) può essere usato per interagire con molti tipi di terreno e di mobili.

Per continuare il tutorial, riempi la bottiglia d'acqua, bevine un po' (premendo <keybind:eat> e selezionando <color_light_cyan>acqua potabile</color>), e infine dirigiti nel corridoio a nord.
There is a <color_light_cyan>dummy</colo:
Di fronte a te c'è un <color_light_cyan>manichino</color>.  Attaccalo.  Per fare ciò, muoviti semplicemente verso di lui.

Una volta che te ne sei occupato, vai verso la porta dietro di lui.
This door is locked. There are several:
Questa porta è bloccata.  Ci sono diversi modi per superare le porte bloccate in gioco (lo scasso e la forzatura sono i più comuni), ma al momento non disponi degli strumenti necessari.  Puoi solamente sfondarla con la tua <color_light_cyan>mazza</color> premendo <keybind:smash> e poi selezionando la direzione.

Ricordati che non tutte le porte possono essere sfondate.  Alcune porte richiedono più forza o un'arma migliore.  Se dopo qualche colpo noti che non stai infliggendo danni, potrebbe essere necessario un approcio diverso.

Per continuare il tutorial, sfonda la porta.
Bashing things is hard work that will de:
Frantumare cose è un lavoro duro che consumerà la tua stamina.  Puoi vedere la tua stamina rimanente nella barra laterale.  Meno ne hai e più lenti saranno i tuoi movimenti e molte delle azioni.  Per recuperare la stamina, ti basta solo attendere.  Puoi premere <keybind:wait> per aprire il menù <color_light_cyan>Aspettare per quanto</color> e scegli l'ammontare di tempo che vuoi attendere.  Scegli l'opzione <color_light_cyan>Aspetta finché non riprendi fiato</color> per recuperare completamente la stamina.

Fai attenzione quando svolgi troppe attività sfiancanti, perché questo ti fa accumulare stanchezza, e ciò provoca penalità al movimento e alle azioni aggiunte al costo di stamina.  Puoi verificare il tuo <color_light_cyan>Livello di Stanchezza</color> nella barra a lato mentre esegui attività che richiedono tempo, così da vedere il loro effetto sulla tua stanchezza.  Per ridurre la tua stanchezza, devi semplicemente riposarti o fare attività meno faticose per un po'.
There is another <color_light_cyan>dummy:
Dietro gli scaffali si trova un altro <color_light_cyan>manichino</color>.  La maggior parte delle armi da mischia richiedono che tu stia adiacente al bersaglio per colpirlo.

Fortunatamente, alcune armi lunghe come le lance sono in grado di compiere attacchi con portata ad una distanza di 2 o 3 quadrati, se quindi ne hai una, non è necessario che ti arrampichi sugli scaffali per essere vicino al manichino.  La <color_light_cyan>lancia d'acciaio</color> ha una portata di 2, puoi quindi colpire il manichino dietro gli scaffali.  Per usare l'attacco con portata, premi il tasto <keybind:fire>.  Una volta scelto il bersaglio, premi <keybind:CONFIRM> per confermare.

Una volta sistemato il manichino, vai nel corridoio a sud.
Always wielding a <color_light_cyan>stee:
Tenere sempre la <color_light_cyan>lancia</color> in mano può essere scomodo.  Per fortuna c'è una <color_light_cyan>cinghia per lance</color> poggiata sullo scaffale.  Puoi indossarla premendo <keybind:wear>.
Per toglierti qualsiasi oggetto indossato, premi <keybind:take_off>.

Per continuare il tutorial, indossa la cinghia per lance.
You can put the <color_light_cyan>steel:
Puoi mettere la <color_light_cyan>lancia</color> nella <color_light_cyan>cinghia per lance</color> per liberarti le mani.  Premi <keybind:apply> per aprire il menù <color_light_cyan>Usa oggetto</color>, seleziona la cinghia per lance, seleziona poi la lancia e infine premi <keybind:CONFIRM> per confermare.

Per continuare il tutorial, metti la <color_light_cyan>lancia d'acciaio</color> nella <color_light_cyan>cinghia per lance</color> e prosegui lungo il corridoio.
Cataclysm uses a container-based invento:
Cataclysm usa un sistema per l'inventario basato sui contenitori.  Per mettere qualcosa nel tuo inventario, devi prima indossare un indumento o contenitore con tasche che forniranno spazio per gli oggetti.  La <color_light_cyan>cinghia per lance</color> ne è un esempio.  Le tasche hanno dimensioni limitate, perciò non vi puoi inserire un oggetto che abbia più volume o sia più lungo della tasca.

Per visualizzare l'inventario, premi <keybind:inventory>.  Vedrai che hai solamente abiti, tra i quali solo i jeans hanno 4 tasche piccole.  Seleziona i tuoi jeans premendo <keybind:CONFIRM> per vedere la loro descrizione e la quantità di tasche.  Per far scorrere la descrizione, premi <keybind:PAGE_UP> e <keybind:PAGE_DOWN>.

Per continuare il tutorial, avvicinati allo scaffale ad ovest e indossa (<keybind:wear>) lo <color_light_cyan>zaino</color> per aumentare la capacità disponibile del tuo inventario.
There is a <color_light_cyan>flashlight<:
Ci sono una <color_light_cyan>torcia elettrica</color> e una <color_light_cyan>batteria monouso</color> sullo scaffale.  Le torce elettriche sono strumenti molto utili in quanto ti permettono di vedere al buio.

Per continuare il tutorial, carica la torcia premendo <keybind:reload_item>, portala con te e vai verso le scale.
A <color_light_cyan>flashlight</color> i:
Una <color_light_cyan>torcia elettrica</color> è indubbiamente utile, ma consuma rapidamente la sua batteria, perciò non durerà a lungo.  Una soluzione decisamente migliore per avere un'illuminazione duratura è una <color_light_cyan>lanterna a petrolio</color>.  Riempi la lanterna con della <color_light_cyan>benzina</color> (<keybind:reload_item>) e attivala (<keybind:apply>) mentre ti trovi vicino.  Un <color_light_cyan>accendino</color> ti sarà utile per accenderla.

Alcuni strumenti (come lampade, essiccatori, bilance da bagno, ecc.) non necessitano di essere raccolti per essere attivati e consentono un utilizzo remoto.

Dopo aver acceso la lanterna puoi spegnere la tua torcia elettrica per risparmiarne l'energia, la lanterna accesa ti fornirà abbastanza luce per compiere qualsiasi azione e durerà molto a lungo.

Per continuare il tutorial, accendi la lanterna e vai verso il corridoio ad est.
Looks like you're hungry! The hunger st:
Sembra che tu sia affamato!  Lo status della fame è indicato nella barra a lato.  Prepara un <color_light_cyan>sandwich al burro di arachidi</color> usando il <color_light_cyan>burro di arachidi</color> e i <color_light_cyan>cracker</color> sul bancone vicino al muro.

Per prepare del cibo devi usare il menù di <color_light_cyan>Fabbricazione</color>.  Premi <keybind:craft> ('e' commerciale) per aprire il menù.  Premi <keybind:NEXT_TAB> e <keybind:PREV_TAB> per scorrere le categorie di fabbricazione e seleziona la catecoria <color_light_cyan>CIBO</color>.  Da lì seleziona sandwich di burro di arachidi e premi <keybind:CONFIRM> per iniziarne la creazione.

Ricorda che non è necessario che tu sia adiacente al bancone per poter fabbricare.  Il <color_light_cyan>raggio di fabbricazione</color> è di 6 quadrati, se quindi non ti trovi a più di 6 tasselli di distanza dai componenti e dagli strumenti, il tuo personaggio è in grado di prenderli da solo.

Per continuare il tutorial, preparati il sandwich al burro di arachidi e mangialo premendo <keybind:eat>.
In the next room, you can find a <color_:
Nella prossima stanza troverai un <color_light_cyan>pennello</color> e qualche barattolo di <color_light_cyan>vernice</color>.  Puoi usarli per dipingere i muri del colore che preferisci.  Per fare questo, apri il menù di <color_light_cyan>Costruzione</color> premendo <keybind:construct> (asterisco) e scorri le categorie usando <keybind:LEFT> e <keybind:RIGHT>.  Trova la categoria <color_light_cyan>Decorazioni</color> e seleziona una delle opzioni per pitturare la parete.

Per continuare il tutorial, dipingi qualche muro e poi muoviti verso sud.
There are 10 <color_light_cyan>baseballs:
Sul pavimento ci sono 10 <color_light_cyan>palle da baseball</color>.  Potresti non avere bisogno di tutte e 10, o potresti non avere abbastanza spazio nel tuo inventario.  Per raccogliere una quantità specifica di oggetti, premi <keybind:pickup>, seleziona il mucchio di oggetti sul pavimento, e premi un numero sulla tastiera (Per mucchi più grandi è possibile digitare più cifre).  Termina infine la selezione con <keybind:INVENTORY:TOGGLE_ENTRY>.  Il cursore dovrebbe diventare il simbolo <color_light_cyan>#</color>.

Puoi lanciare una palla da baseball al <color_light_cyan>manichino</color> in fondo al corridoio premendo <keybind:throw>.

Per completare il tutorial, lancia qualche palla da baseball al manichino e poi vai in fondo al corridoio a nord.
Congratulations! You have completed the:
Congratulazioni!  Hai completato il tutorial.  Ecco qualche consiglio dell'ultimo minuto.

Puoi premere <keybind:action_menu> per aprire il <color_light_cyan>menù delle Azioni</color>.  È un modo comodo per eseguire molte azioni.

Sei incerto su quale tasto usare in un determinato menù?  Premi <keybind:HELP_KEYBINDINGS> per aprire il menù dei <color_light_cyan>Comandi</color>.  Ti permette di verificare l'attuale configurazione dei comandi e di cambiarli a tuo piacimento.  Alcune azioni poco usate o poco convenienti non hanno un tasto preconfigurato, anche quelle possono essere impostate lì.

Puoi continuare ad esplorare le stanze del tutorial, o puoi uscire dal tutorial premendo <keybind:save>.  Ciò salverà la partita e tornerai al menù principale.

Its distended lungs seem to be partially: Its distended lungs seem to be partially lined with a black and sticky mucus membrane.
Black liquid bubbles in the places where: Black liquid bubbles in the places where you managed to remove its skeletal growths.
The sputters of acid on your gear you ea: The sputters of acid on your gear you earned by digging into this corpse could maybe warrant the use of some water to douse.
Pressed against the liver is a swollen g: Pressed against the liver is a swollen gland the size of a golfball, still somewhat functioning, pumping out acrid fluids.
Most cavities in its anatomy seem to hav: Most cavities in its anatomy seem to have been filled with an acidic solution mixed with a foul black liquid and pieces of its slowly melting tissues.
You have to step back as a gland you ina: You have to step back as a gland you inadvertently cut into seems to perform a neutralization reaction between its contents and the rest of its fluids.
The lingering shadows surrounding it mak: The lingering shadows surrounding it make your work quite a lot harder as they seem to deliberately grow more opaque around your tool as if they wished to hide the monster's secrets.
You spot a few pores still weakly sputte: You spot a few pores still weakly sputtering thin puffs of black smoke, investigating them further reveals glands full of fuming black liquid linked to the pores with long tubes.
You make one incision and the resulting: You make one incision and the resulting cloud of black smoke forces you to take a short break as it becomes impossible to see anything.
Despite it not being very evident from t: Despite it not being very evident from the outside, it seems the entire digestive tract of the abomination was bloated with its obscuring smoke.
The inner tissues are a mosaic of somewh: The inner tissues are a mosaic of somewhat normal flesh and flesh interlaced with fibers of the armor.
Separating what is flesh and what is syn: Separating what is flesh and what is synthetic is difficult, as some parts appear to be between the two.
Fibers of kevlar-like material spread th: Fibers of kevlar-like material spread through the body like a cobweb, originating from a tiny entry wound in the abdomen.
You cut off some scraps of the uniform t: You cut off some scraps of the uniform that were still adhered to the body, finding tendrils of flesh anchored into them.
Upon closer examination, some of the kev: Upon closer examination, some of the kevlar isn't kevlar - its off color and composition suggest it's the creature's flesh reformed to imitate it.
Some strands of the bulletproof material: Some strands of the bulletproof material snake deep into the body like roots of an invading organism.
Strong fibers run alongside the muscles: Strong fibers run alongside the muscles in a way that you want to compare to marbling.
The sheer scale of the carcass leaves yo: The sheer scale of the carcass leaves you only with a luxury of choice on where to start your work.
Its legs seem to have been reinforced wi: Its legs seem to have been reinforced with a strange lattice of skeletal bracing and muscle fibers to support its immense bulk.
Along joints in the limbs and torso you: Along joints in the limbs and torso you find strange new muscly organs filled with fluid, suggesting this behemoth moved with some form of organic hydraulics.
Portions of the spine and surrounding bo: Portions of the spine and surrounding bones have grown and fused into a single piece, presumably to hold up the creature's bulk - but even then, it still shows signs of strain.
The ropey muscles are still unbelievably: The ropey muscles are still unbelievably tense along the corpse's back, your own back aches just looking at them.
You find that shoulder and upper arm bon: You find that shoulder and upper arm bones are supported by smaller, similar bone growths.
The more delicate joints in the body suc: The more delicate joints in the body such as the wrists and neck have fused with surrounding tissue.
Your search for the source of the creatu: Your search for the source of the creature's size has you discover a cluster of glandular organs deep in the body, most of which you are unable to identify.
The overall anatomy of this enormous mon: The overall anatomy of this enormous monstrosity leaves you only to wonder how it possibly could achieve the range of motion you witnessed while it was still standing.
You cut into its abdomen, and discover i: You cut into its abdomen, and discover its utter lack of internal organs, the expected cavity replaced by nothing but more flesh and muscle.
The sheer remaining tension in each of t: The sheer remaining tension in each of the muscles of its arms and shoulders makes them unwind with a sonorous thwang each time you cut one off the supporting bones.
You realize the muscles of the zombie's: You realize the muscles of the zombie's arms are hollow, their marrow replaced by a thick oily black liquid.  You wonder if the ridiculous muscle mass surrounding them is the other half of a strange hydraulic system.
You cut into the arms of the creature an: You cut into the arms of the creature and realize that instead of what you would expect from what you know of normal human anatomy, its muscles wind around the bones in what looks like a tight spring.
While you are cutting into it, the creat: While you are cutting into it, the creature suddenly moves and grabs one of your limbs.  Despite considerable effort, you are unable to pry open the creature's iron grip and resign yourself to chop off the hand instead.
You notice cysts in its fur, you cut int: You notice cysts in its fur, you cut into them and alternatively find acrid fluids, flakes of bone or twitching strands of muscle.
Inside its muzzle you notice strange gla: Inside its muzzle you notice strange glands and fibrous growths, almost as if the creature's sense of smell was in the process of being overhauled.
Lodged into the neck area of the creatur: Lodged into the neck area of the creature and grown over you find a corroded tag reading the following "Max my best friend forever".
You find strange tubular glands across t: You find strange tubular glands across the creature contained alternating layers of two alien tissue types soaked in a black liquid, its smell putrid but saltier than usual for a zombie.
Uncomfortable static forces you to groun: Uncomfortable static forces you to ground yourself multiple times during your work.
The creature's heart seems to still be b: The creature's heart seems to still be beating, but rather than pumping blood, it strangely reminds you of some sort of biological dynamo.
There are bundles of nerves snaking all: There are bundles of nerves snaking all throughout the tissues, still channeling small amounts of electricity.
The blackened veins of the creature seem: The blackened veins of the creature seem strangely rigid, and you see faint crackles of electricity course across them.
Despite the carcass lying still, you sti: Despite the carcass lying still, you still notice churning while investigating its entrails, as if whatever was originally animating this corpse is wrestling with the mycelium fibers to retake control.
The skin feels absolutely turgid, oozing: The skin feels absolutely turgid, oozing water mixed in with traces of a black liquid where you make your incisions.
Fungal stalks still sway gently despite: Fungal stalks still sway gently despite the lack of movement of the formerly shambling corpse.
The putrefied blood that leaks from your: The putrefied blood that leaks from your incisions is visibly saturated with spores.
The cavities of this creature are filled: The cavities of this creature are filled with lethargic winged creatures hanging off tubes oozing a greyish milky substance.
The corpse is inundated with smaller for: The corpse is inundated with smaller forms, increasing in complexity and size as you near its central cavity where they wait for their release in neat clusters.
The inside of this carcass resembles mor: The inside of this carcass resembles more an industrial production line than anything vaguely natural.
You are almost certain this zombie was p: You are almost certain this zombie was pregnant before its undeath, the fetus within the womb having been twisted into the abomination it was carrying.

Welcome to Frozen Hell, an unofficial hi: Welcome to Frozen Hell, an unofficial history of Salus IV by Bette Lapin.  Salus IV was founded in the early days of the Hyperspace Era as a joint venture between Mercurial Genomics and a Soviet Design Bureau.  At its height several hundred years ago Salus IV had just over 110 million citizens (including both uplifts and humans). However, that population had begun to decline even before the Discontinuity as people migrated to planets that, while more hostile to life during the earliest colonization phases than Salus IV, were much simpler to terraform into a place more enjoyable by human and uplift citizens.
Even during the Discontinuity Salus IV's: Even during the Discontinuity Salus IV's population continued to drop as there were easier places to live even in the Salus system - from honeycombed asteroid habitats to domed cities with gorgeous views.  Mercurial Genomics was an early member of the nascent post-Discontinuity government efforts.  As a result of this membership, they have successfully reclaimed Salus IV in the court system set up by ESCA.  The Whately family, which runs Mercurial Genomics, began leasing development and exploitation permits and allows the establishment of minor UICA outposts within Salus IV.  There is an official citizen count of less than twenty thousand sentient beings, albeit mostly in orbit.  It is believed, however, that there are at least that many non-citizen sentients spread amongst squatter, smuggler, pirate, and feral uplift communities.

The Salus system is what is called a hin: The Salus system is what is called a hinge system for the new FTL travels.  This system contains a number of easy exit points to star systems that have no other easy way to travel to each other than through a series of systems with low to zero civilization in them.  Salus has several interstellar refueling points.  These stations are often blind to each other as the planets and other objects rotate around the sun.  Mercurial seems to have no interest in managing or protecting the traffic that flows through the Salus system or in neighboring systems beyond the bare minimum effort required by UICA.  As a result of this neglect; victims of pirate attacks, engine failure and other critical issues regularly limp to whatever safety they can find in the Salus system.  Unfortunately for many of them they will crash land on Salus IV where there are few regular shuttles between its scattered ports and the outside universe.  As the locals are fond of saying 'Getting to Salus IV is hard, getting off may be impossible'.

An implanted AI module calculates the op: An implanted AI module calculates the optimal followup to each of your melee strikes, allowing you to chain them with unnatural speed and grace.  This bionic must be active to function.

The chemical injection system and microc: The chemical injection system and microcomputer that when activated greatly enhances your reaction times and overall speed.  Upon deactivation, the user may experience dizziness, heart palpitations and ravenous appetites.

The chemical injection system and microcomputer that when activated gives a burst of chemicals that allows your blood to work a little harder at stabilizing the body and then flushes your system with a powerful anesthetic that allows you to continue operating at high capacity.  Upon deactivation, the user may experience extreme lethargy, sudden loss of consciousness, among other symptoms that may prove potentially fatal if not in a safe location.
A battered and used Compact Bionics Modu: A battered and used Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 50 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
Imagine a computer inside your body play: Imagine a computer inside your body playing pong against the universe. The HawkingCorps GravyField Mark II was: The HawkingCorps GravyField Mark II was designed for police actions during food riots and other civilian uprisings. This class of personal gravity manipulat: This class of personal gravity manipulator often sees action on both sides of the vicious ship-to-ship boarding fights that are common with both repossession and piracy. The PEC, as it is commonly known, works: La PEC, come è comunemente nota, funziona convertendo l'energia cinetica in forme meno dannose per chi la indossa, come la luce. Tuttavia, la capacità di fermare i danni balistici e perforanti sul nascere spesso compensa gli eventuali inconvenienti che queste emissioni possono causare. Personal shielding against bullets and s: Personal shielding against bullets and sharp-pointed weapons comes in a variety of types. It looks like a glob of white plastic st: It looks like a glob of white plastic streaked with bits of red and black has melted over a jagged chunk of mixed scrap metals.  There are two large and sharp pieces of metal jutting out from the side in parallel.  The metal is very slightly, inexplicably slimy to the touch.  If you hold it up to your ear, it emits a low, oscillating hum very quietly.  Unsettling…
It's a brown, flaky rock just bigger tha: It's a brown, flaky rock just bigger than your fist.  Horrifically, what seem to be small animal bones stick out of it at weird angles.  Something that looks suspiciously like blood very slowly oozes out from between the layers in the rock - almost imperceptibly slow - almost as if something living were freshly crushed between the sedimentary layers.  But that would be impossible…
It's a small wooden cuboid with a large:
It's a small wooden cuboid with a large rectangular hole running from one side to the other.  The wood is well-treated and it seems completely mundane at first.

If you look through the hole, everything looks normal.  It's only when you wave your hand in front that you realize that you can't see yourself!  If you stick your finger inside the hole, it doesn't seem to come out the other side.  How is that possible?!
You could be wrong, but it appears to be: You could be wrong, but it appears to be maybe 6 or 7 colorful glass bongs fused together in a ball-shaped mess of melted glass, reminding you strangely of an art exhibition you saw once.  When you pick up the object, you notice a pale purple ooze trapped in the middle of the glass meld.  It's iridescent, colloidal, and slightly viscous, although it doesn't remind you of any fluid you've ever seen before.
It's colored jet black and looks suspici: È di colore nero corvino e assomiglia in modo sospetto al corno increspato di una capra, solo apparentemente tempestato di gemme rosse e scolpito con iscrizioni. Non sei un esperto, ma queste iscrizioni sono diverse da qualsiasi cosa tu abbia mai visto fare dagli umani, con molte forme geometriche all'interno di quadrati che potrebbero essere parole o caratteri. Ci sono linee sottili e intricate che si intrecciano su tutto il corno, curvandosi in un modo che sei sicuro potrebbe essere ottenuto solo con la tecnologia dell'incisione laser, ma sei sicuro che non lo fossero.
It appears like a normal book with a bri: It appears like a normal book with a bright blue cover from a distance, but when you pick the object up you notice it's simply a thick slab of some dense material shaped like a book.  It's oddly stocky and brightly colored, textured with low-resolution images almost like an object that fell straight out of an old video game.  On the cover is just the number "19" and below it the words "A new bible by" but there's no author listed.  In fact, there's no other text on the entire object.
It seems to be a heavy chunk of light pi:
Sembra essere un pezzo pesante di ambra rosa chiaro. Nell'ambra sono sospesi... dei fossili? Non sei sicuro di come chiamarli. 

Uno sembra essere una piccola palla di capelli con fili di rame che si protendono in una direzione, ricordando un'ameba che cerca qualcosa. Un'altra sembra essere una minuscola felce, fatta solo di un metallo altamente iridescente, con lame letteralmente sottili come un rasoio. Un terzo, particolarmente terrificante, sembra essere la testa rimpicciolita di un essere umano con una rete di nervi rosso scuro al posto dei capelli.
It seems almost like a children's toy ha: It seems almost like a children's toy has somehow melted into a solid chunk of brass.  There are bright red, green, and yellow plastic pieces fused into the sides and a very distinct purple button in the middle.  When you press it, however, there's a sickening squelch and you can't help but feel like you're pressing into a pile of ground meat protected by this metal outer shell.  Disgusting.
It seems like a small, jagged rock unifo: It seems like a small, jagged rock uniformly and evenly covered in bright red velvet.  You feel certain that the rock came to be this way through some supernatural process.  When you hold it to your ear, it emits a very low, oscillating hum.  Very strange.
It appears to be a small black box made:
It appears to be a small black box made out of some kind of hard metal.  Although it has no discernable openings, you call it a box because when you shake it you can feel things moving around inside.  Strangely, though, what's inside always seems to be… changing.  One moment it's a liquid, the next it feels like marbles or rocks, and then the next it feels like sand.

Although probably inconsequential, the object emits a fairly strong odor of ginger at all times.

A drab gray drywall barrier with no fini: A drab gray drywall barrier with no finishing.  Feels almost damp to the touch and smells faintly of cleaner chemicals.

HALLOWAY ANNOUNCES SWEEPING BUDGET BILL.  As rhetoric surrounding national defense spending ramps up, Senate Majority Leader Halloway has announced a controversial bill that would cut over $700 billion from multiple federal organizations, including arts funding and welfare.  He introduced the bill by saying, "We stand on the edge of a new age of science and discovery, and a new age of danger from enemies abroad.  Hardworking Americans can benefit most by getting involved in our new civilian science programs and making a difference there.  No more sitting at home playing video games!"

KIDNAPPING IN WESTFIELD? After a week o: KIDNAPPING IN WESTFIELD?  After a week of intense searching, chasing leads across the state, the Oriole County Sheriff's Department have still uncovered no leads in the disappearance of Kasey Akron, 31, postal worker and mother of two.  Akron disappeared without a trace while on the job in Westfield, a small village with a population of only 824, on September 24th.  Her vehicle was found still running, undelivered mail left inside.  Her mother tearfully testified to the Oriole Free Press, "Kasey was a happy and loved woman.  Wherever she is, we know she wants to come home!"  Detectives previously suggested that Akron may have departed with someone she knew, but have not made any arrests so far.

"Palla" è un vecchio termine per indicare proiettili interamente rivestiti in metallo che offrono minore incrostazione, migliore affidabilità e penetrazione leggermente migliorata rispetto al piombo semplice.

Modern rifle ammunition, ubiquitous and affordable.  It's suitable for international conflicts, hunting small to large game, home defense, and these days, zombies.  This 'armor piercing' variant features a mild steel penetrator for environmental friendliness, improved barrier penetration, and enhanced effect on armor.
Foreign rifle ammo brought by the Exodii: Foreign rifle ammo brought by the Exodii, and very common amongst them.
Projectile used for a railgun. It's mad: Projectile used for a railgun.  It's made of a ferromagnetic metal, probably cobalt.
Huge rifle ammunition like this bridges: Huge rifle ammunition like this bridges the gap between light cannons and big game rifles.  It's suitable for taking on light vehicles and other materiel, or hunting extremely large game.  'Ball' is an old term for full metal jacketed bullets which offer reduced fouling, better reliability, and slightly improved penetration compared to plain lead.

Huge rifle ammunition like this bridges the gap between light cannons and big game rifles.  It's suitable for taking on light vehicles and other materiel, or hunting extremely large game.  These armor piercing munitions feature tungsten steel penetrators for use against light-skinned vehicles.
A large anti-personnel rocket for a mili: A large anti-personnel rocket for a military rocket launcher.  Designed to be highly effective against personnel.
An anti-tank rocket with a high explosiv: An anti-tank rocket with a high explosive dual purpose warhead for a military rocket launcher.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures, and retains some effectiveness against personnel.
A rocket loaded with a smoke warhead for: A rocket loaded with a smoke warhead for a military rocket launcher.  Commonly used for signaling, target designation, and for screening troop movements.
A beanbag round for shotguns, not deadly: Un proiettile non letale da fucile a pompa, ideato per inabilitare.
A shotshell filled with numerous small p: A shotshell filled with numerous small pellets.  Designed for hunting birds and other small game, its applications in combat are very limited.
A shotshell with a single projectile, sh: A shotshell with a single projectile, shaped somewhat like a shuttlecock.  Slugs are used with shotguns to give them extra range, allowing them to stand in for a rifle.  Extremely damaging but rather inaccurate.
A shotgun shell filled with whatever was: Una cartuccia per fucile a pallettoni caricata con tutto ciò che hai trovato in giro. Fà più danno dei pallini, ma è molto più impreciso.
This antiquated single shot pistol would: Questa antiquata pistola a colpo singolo completerebbe perfettamente l'outfit di un pirata. Sebbene il suo caricamento possa essere lento, non richiede l'accensione di involucri di ottone ed è teoricamente sostenibile. La portata e la precisione sono ostacolate dalla mancanza di rigatura, ma questo vecchio design è ancora molto letale.
This is an old revolver designed during: Questo è un antico revolver fabbricato durante la corsa al Far West. Ogni colpo richiede una cartuccia di carta riempita di polvere nera, che allunga abbastanza i tempi di ricarica. Nonostante l'età, quest'arma è in grado di eliminare tutt'ora la maggior parte delle minacce a due gambe.
An antique design, this smoothbore long: An antique design, this smoothbore long arm would look more at home on a pre-1850's battlefield than in your hands in the cataclysm.  Its loading may be slow, but it does not require brass casings to fire, and is theoretically sustainable to fire.  Range and accuracy are hampered by lack of rifling, but this time-tested design is plenty lethal.
An older single shot grenade launcher, l: An older single shot grenade launcher, looking something like a sawn off shotgun.  Though it's mostly been replaced by underbarrel launchers, dedicated models like this have seen use by law enforcement and riot personnel.  Still deadly against hard or soft targets, depending on what cartridges are available.
This large, clumsy looking launcher look: This large, clumsy looking launcher looks like the offspring of a machine gun and a mortar; its bore is huge, and its action is just as massive.  A huge belt of grenade cartridges loads into its tray, allowing several grenades to be launched in rapid succession.  If one grenade fired from this isn't enough to solve your problems, surely a dozen more are.  This must be mounted on a frame to be fired, and reloading is a bit slow.
A stubby single shot pistol with a large: A stubby single shot pistol with a large bore barrel, suitable for launching grenades or flares.  This is a slightly more convenient way to transport a grenade launcher than mounted to one's rifle, a practice more common among special forces.  In more recent years, variants were sold commercially to ostensibly launch flares.  With the right cartridges, this would be devastating against hard or soft targets.  This could be attached to a suitable rifle, if so desired.
Looking something like a large revolver: Looking something like a large revolver from a cartoon this launcher is capable of firing six grenades in rapid succession.  Its huge cylinder is wound by a clock spring, which hastens firing, but slows reloading, as it must be re-wound.  Needless to say, six well placed shots is an incredible amount of firepower, depending on the cartridges loaded.
Since the early days of western expansio: Since the early days of western expansion, when ammunition supply was infrequent, shooters sought to share ammo between their sidearms and long arms.  This tube magazine lever-action carbine allows the shooter to reduce the number of calibers carried and squeeze more power from their pistol ammunition.
This pistol is a tiny machinegun you can: This pistol is a tiny machinegun you can stuff into a holster, with which you could dump its magazine at a blistering rate into any close range foes.  Machine pistols mostly see use by vehicle crewmen or bodyguards of VIPs.  Due to its preposterous rate of fire it is difficult to control.
A modern pistol fit for duty, military s: A modern pistol fit for duty, military service, or personal defense, with a detachable box magazine and a reliable action.  Though its chambering is capable of meeting FBI penetration minimums, the lack of a shoulder stock limits its utility.
These small carbines share ammunition an: These small carbines share ammunition and magazines with common pistols, offering a more controllable carbine than a normal rifle, while also reducing ammunition costs.  Because of their compatibility, they pair well with duty pistols, allowing one to transition to a more stable weapon without carrying extra ammo or magazines.
Revolvers like this, chambered for stand: Revolvers like this, chambered for standard defensive calibers, were a favorite of police departments for nearly a century, up until the 1986 Miami shootout.  Afterwards, the slow reloading and shooting of revolvers were considered liabilities; still, this model's accuracy and moderate recoil make for a serviceable sidearm, and there are no magazines for you to lose or damage.
Chambered in common pistol ammunition, t: Chambered in common pistol ammunition, this compact long arm is perfect for trench raiders, vehicular crewmen, SWAT teams and special forces.  Though not as accurate as a proper rifle, especially at longer ranges, it is very controllable in automatic fire.  It feeds from detachable box magazines, which are easy to unload into close range targets.
A crudely constructed fully automatic su: Una mitraglietta automatica costruita grossolanamente, in grado di usare caricatori standard per pistole e mitragliette.  Il suo pesante otturatore rende difficile sparare con precisione, mentre la sua dubbia natura di assemblaggio la rende poco affidabile e non molto duratura.  Alcuni design analoghi, frutto della disperazione, hanno servito bene le proprie nazioni durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale, dunque dovrebbe essere sufficiente per gli zombie… Giusto?  Utilizza munizioni per pistola.
This large pistol is almost as heavy as: This large pistol is almost as heavy as a small carbine, and just about as powerful too.  Chambered in hard hitting magnum calibers, it is suitable for hunting medium game, humans, or offsetting any of one's perceived deficiencies.  Though traditionally such magnums are revolvers, this one is a magazine fed semi-automatic.
A modern re-imagining of the classic wes: A modern re-imagining of the classic western lever-action, this larger rifle accepts powerful magnum pistol ammunition as well as weaker pistol ammo.  Carrying this along side a magnum pistol would allow one to reduce the number of calibers carried, and allow you to squeeze more power from ammunition.
A crudely constructed carbine, chambered: A crudely constructed carbine, chambered for magnum pistol ammo and standard pistol ammo.  It feeds from commercial magnum pistol magazines, and locks with a rudimentary lever-action system.  Its powerful cartridge and relative precision should serve well against zombies and medium game.
A firearm made from a stout pipe, reinfo: A firearm made from a stout pipe, reinforced at the chamber.  It holds a single a round of standard or magnum pistol ammunition, and has a crude assembly to fire it.  There's no extractor, so it might be slow to reload, and its construction makes for poor reliability and longevity.
Early handgun hunters helped develop thi: I primi cacciatori di pistole contribuirono a sviluppare le munizioni magnum di questo revolver da calibri standard, che necessitavano di revolver più pesanti per sparare in sicurezza. I cilindri di questi revolver possono quindi alloggiare sia munizioni magnum che munizioni standard. Potresti prendere selvaggina di dimensioni medio-grandi con questo pezzo pesante.
With near non-existent recoil and inexpe: With near non-existent recoil and inexpensive ammunition, rifles like this one are popular introductory firearms.  It has a built in magazine, capable of holding an impressive amount of its small cartridges.  You could take small game with this, but anything bigger might not even notice.
This medium sized pistol fires cheap and: This medium sized pistol fires cheap and plentiful plinking ammo, and is exceptionally popular for practice or target shooting.  This pistol is unsuited for taking on anything but small game, as it is meant to poke holes in paper.  Accepts box magazines.
A crude single shot firearm made from im: A crude single shot firearm made from improvised or homemade components, chambered for tiny plinking ammunition.  Zip guns like these often turned up in the hands of criminals and insurgents.  There's no extractor, so it might be slow to reload, and its construction leaves its longevity in question.
The products of decades of improvement,: The products of decades of improvement, rifle such as this are handy, reliable, and adaptable.  An 'assault rifle', it is capable of providing both accurate semi-automatic fire and bursts of automatic fire.  Short of large creatures and light vehicles, this should take care of most of your problems out to several hundred meters.
The light machine gun is a formidable im: The light machine gun is a formidable implement for suppressive fire, an important part of squad tactics.  Its belt feed allows for hundreds of rounds to be loaded, and its heavy components can withstand long bursts of fire.  While perhaps not as precise as a service rifle, a light machinegun does allow for a considerable amount of energy to be sent down range.  Slow to reload.
Sniper rifles fill military, police and: Sniper rifles fill military, police and civilian needs for precise, accurate fire.  Modern examples feature detachable magazines and various mounting interfaces for optics and supports.  With care and practice, all should be quite capable of eliminating bipedal threats from very safe ranges.
Though often mislabeled an assault rifle: Though often mislabeled an assault rifle, this common, cheap magazine fed carbine isn't capable of automatic fire.  While almost as effective as a proper rifle, the wider variety of components and varying levels of maintenance make these less reliable than their military brethren.  These rifles are just as adequate for taking on anything smaller than large game, however.
A battle rifle popular among the Exodii.  Reliable and powerful, though slightly unwieldy to use as an infantry weapon.  Just different enough from local weaponry that the same ammunition cannot be shared between them.
A sniper rifle popular among the Exodii.  Just different enough from local weaponry that the same ammunition cannot be shared between them.
A handheld railgun which magnetically pr: A handheld railgun which magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Powered by UPS.
A break action firearm comprised of a ri: A break action firearm comprised of a rifle barrel over two smooth bore shotgun barrels.  Historically used by egomaniac hunters in Africa, now used by their egomaniac descendants in New England.
Large, intimidating, and overbuilt, this: Large, intimidating, and overbuilt, this hefty rifle fires huge projectiles with relative precision.  Though it resembles a sniper rifle, this anti-material weapon is best suited for blinding tanks, shooting at aircraft, or destroying explosives.  It feeds from comically oversized magazines.
Elegantly engraved, with deep glossy blu: Elegantemente inciso, con acciaio azzurrato lucido e legno figurato, questo doppio fucile ad azione basculante è quasi troppo bello da sparare. La tua spalla potrebbe implorarti di non farlo; le camere sono larghe quasi abbastanza per due dita e il rinculo è mostruoso. Probabilmente potresti uccidere chiunque con questo, specialmente se sparassi con entrambi i barili contemporaneamente.
This large, ungainly belt-fed machine g: This large, ungainly  belt-fed machine gun fires huge projectiles, originally intended for turn of the century anti-vehicular use.  While no longer suitable for modern tanks or aircraft, thinner skinned vehicles or drones are just as susceptible, as are any other 'smaller' threats.  Slow to reload, incredibly loud, and must be mounted to be fired.
Constructed of fiberglass, with crude pl: Constructed of fiberglass, with crude plastic sights and a titanium barrel, this is a launcher for a single rocket.  Though not as effective as other anti-armor weapons, the true value in this disposable rocket launcher is its portability and lack of dead weight once expended.  Has a backblast, so make sure nothing you mind destroying is behind you.
This heavy, gigantic rifled tube feature: This heavy, gigantic rifled tube features a complex optical sight and can launch a wide variety of payloads, including rockets or laser guided missiles.  Depending on the warhead loaded, such weapons are effective against older tanks, most vehicles, bunkers and personnel.  These are meant to be operated by a two-man crew, so reloading might be a bit slow.  Its recoilless design allows for superior range and damage, but it produces tremendous backblast, so make sure nothing you mind destroying is behind you.
An old-fashioned double barreled shotgun: Un fucile a doppia canna vecchio stile, con un grilletto per ciascuna canna. Le riprese successive sono incredibilmente veloci con questo, ma la ricarica è un po' lenta. Le cartucce sono disponibili in molte varietà e i fucili da caccia sono adatti a qualsiasi cosa, dalla selvaggina di grandi dimensioni ai piccoli uccelli.
A crudely handmade double barreled shotg: A crudely handmade double barreled shotgun, with a trigger for each barrel.  Follow up shots are incredibly quick with this, but reloading is slow, as there are no extractors or ejectors.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.
A simple, popular design, sporting shotg: A simple, popular design, sporting shotguns are used by law enforcement, civilians and occasionally militaries.  Its internal magazine is small by modern standards, and reloading can be quite slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.
A simple, shotgun without a stock used b: A simple, shotgun without a stock used by law enforcement and occasionally militaries.  Its internal magazine is small, and reloading can be quite slow.  Shotshells come in many varieties, and shotguns are suitable for anything from some large game to small birds.
A detachable magazine fed shotgun, mostl: A detachable magazine fed shotgun, mostly oriented towards overly enthusiastic civilians.  Featuring rails and a menacing black appearance, this sort of shotgun doesn't really look like it has a sporting use.  The magazines reduce lengthy reloading times associated with shotguns.  Though known for being somewhat finicky, these can be tuned to run with some reliability.
A crude shotgun, composed of two thick s: A crude shotgun, composed of two thick steel pipes, an end cap and a nail.  The lack of sights make this weapon only useful at point-blank range.
Small shotgun, assembled from underbarre: Small shotgun, assembled from underbarrel shotgun modification and a pistol grip.  Not the best weapon, but has a really small size and weight.
A stubby single shot launcher with a lar: A stubby single shot launcher with a large bore barrel, suitable for launching grenades or flares.  This launcher can be attached to a rifle or other suitable platform, and includes its own set of sights.  In more recent years, variants were sold commercially to ostensibly launch flares.  With the right cartridges, this would be devastating against hard or soft targets.  The launcher can be detached and its sights reattached to the could be disassembled and attached to a suitable rifle, if so desired.
A stubby single shot launcher for launch: A stubby single shot launcher for launching grenades or flares.  This launcher can be attached to a rifle or other suitable platform, and includes its own set of sights.  In more recent years, variants were sold commercially to ostensibly launch flares.  With the right cartridges, this would be devastating against hard or soft targets.  A crude homemade bracket has been attached, allowing a wider variety of hosts.
An ammo belt consisting of metal linkage: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which separate from the belt upon firing.  This one holds grenade cartridges and is too bulky to be worn like other ammo belts.
A flush fitting magazine for use with pi: A flush fitting magazine for use with pistols and submachine guns.  Holds 15 rounds of standard pistol ammo.
A long stick magazine for use with pisto: A long stick magazine for use with pistols and submachine guns.  Holds 30 rounds of standard pistol ammo.
A 'speedloader', a metal block capable o: A 'speedloader', a metal block capable of holding and releasing ammunition to aid in loading revolvers.  Accepts 6 standard or magnum pistol cartridges.
A flush fitting magazine for use with ta: A flush fitting magazine for use with target pistols, capable of feeding 10 tiny pistol cartridges.
An ammo belt consisting of metal linkage: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which separate from the belt upon firing.  Holds rifle ammunition.
A 30 round standard capacity magazine fo: Un caricatore di capacità standard da 30 colpi per fucili di servizio, più economico del costo di un pasto grazie alla sua adozione da parte di quasi tutti gli altri fucili comuni. Sono fatti di alluminio e originariamente dovevano essere usa e getta, quindi non sono i più durevoli; non lasciare che si danneggino.
A short 5 round steel magazine compatibl: A short 5 round steel magazine compatible with nearly every common rifle.  Although it has a low capacity it is easy to store and quick to reload.
An unreasonably large magazine for the u: An unreasonably large magazine for the unusual Exodii rifles, custom designed and manufactured by the Exodii.
A small, sleek magazine for the unusual: A small, sleek magazine for the unusual Exodii sniper rifles.
A railgun rifle magazine which can hold: A railgun rifle magazine which can hold up to 20 ferromagnetic projectiles.
A tiny piece of grooved metal designed t: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load ten rifle rounds into a magazine.
An ammo belt consisting of metal linkage: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which separate from the belt upon firing.  Holds huge rifle ammunition.
An 8 round box magazine for tactical sho: An 8 round box magazine for tactical shotguns.  Shotshells tend to not work well in box magazines due to their plastic hulls and the compression from the magazine spring.
A remote weapon system derived from the: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  Thousands of these were deployed by the US military before the Cataclysm and they were valued for their use in engaging anything up to light vehicles at long range without exposing the operator.  This one is fitted with a heavy machinegun.

Un sistema d'arma remoto derivato dall'M153 CROWS II e potenziato con un software di funzionamento autonomo. Migliaia di questi furono schierati dalle forze armate statunitensi prima del cataclisma ed erano apprezzati per il loro utilizzo nell'ingaggio della fanteria senza esporre l'operatore. Questo è dotato di una mitragliatrice leggera.
A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with a revolver grenade launcher.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.
These TALON-derived riot control platfor: These TALON-derived riot control platforms were widely publicized a few years before the cataclysm as a new semi-autonomous device that could fire less-lethal rounds with far more accuracy than a human, ensuring safer hits against a target's limbs.  They were quickly adopted by prisons and inner city police forces, where they demonstrated that 'less lethal' is not the same as 'non-lethal'.  In the days before the cataclysm, massive stockrooms of the things were put into circulation.  On the bright side, although it shoots autonomously, it requires a human operator to relocate, so it's not so mobile anymore.
This is an inactive turret. Using this: This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded ball heavy machine gun ammunition rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its heavy machine gun.

This is an inactive turret. If programmed successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its light machine gun.

This is an inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded ball pistol ammunition in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammo you do NOT want to give the turret) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its SMG.
This is an inactive TALON UGV equipped w: This is an inactive TALON UGV equipped with an assault rifle.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded ball rifle ammo in inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever rifle ammo you do NOT want to give the robot) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the security bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its rifle.

This is an inactive TALON UGV equipped with a six shot grenade launcher.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the HEDP grenade cartridges in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever grenades you do NOT want to give the robot) turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the UGV will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its grenade launcher.

You could build a hive, if only you were: Potresti costruire un alveare, se solo fossi migliore. Cosa ti manca?
More of the <color_yellow> good nectar</: Più di<color_yellow>buon nettare</color>. Questo è ciò di cui hai bisogno.
You can't be expected to metamorphose wi: Non puoi aspettarti di trasformarti con così poco. Hai bisogno di più.
You need enough insect primer and cataly: Hai bisogno di abbastanza primer e catalizzatore per insetti nel tuo sistema mentre dormi per completare il cambiamento.

You and your sisters have worked diligen: Tu e le tue sorelle avete lavorato diligentemente, rendendo la vostra casa sicura e prospera. Ti sentivi così orgoglioso. Ma ultimamente la mamma cresce più lentamente e ci sono più celle vuote che nella covata. Vedi esitazione anche sulle tue sorelle... l'alveare ha bisogno che tu faccia un passo avanti? Lo avrebbero seguito? Potresti sconfiggerla?
You dream of a dark, damp place permeate: Sogni un luogo buio e umido permeato dall'odore della segatura. Hai la sensazione che questo sia tutto ciò che hai mai conosciuto, ogni piega sui muri e ogni graffio sul pavimento è opera tua. Ti senti come a casa, ma nel profondo sai che dovrai cambiare ed emergere nell'esterno pericoloso e martoriato dalla luce.
You have stuffed yourself to bursting fo: Ti sei saziato fino a scoppiare per la quarta volta oggi, ma la tua fame non si placa. Avresti bisogno di sfuggire alla tua pelle troppo piccola per poter mangiare a sufficienza, ne sei sicuro. Porta il coltello su una delle smagliature sulla schiena e separa la pelle: scatterà di lato facilmente e senza dolore. Procedi lungo i fianchi, cambiando il coltello tra le mani secondo necessità e liberando la mano<color_light_green>nuova pelle</color>dalla sua prigione carnosa.

Your try going about your day as usual,: Cerchi di svolgere la tua giornata come al solito, ma la tua vista sembra oscurarsi ogni pochi secondi senza motivo. Ti raggiungi gli occhi con fastidio e senti una disgustosa membrana carnosa che li copre periodicamente con un movimento cigolante e umido. Dopo un altro giorno di frastornata mondanità torni a casa nel tuo squallido appartamento in cantina, ma sbagli un passo e cadi dalle scale, atterrandoti in faccia con un tonfo umido. La coscienza svanisce, ma il dolore rimane. Ti svegli, perdendo gli strani ricordi della scimmia, e rimani sbalordito da una vertiginosa cavalcata di colori che non avresti mai potuto immaginare prima. Trovi una rientranza adatta, ti blocchi sul posto e **spingi**, cercando di strappare il tuo vecchio esoscheletro con la pressione della tua nuova armatura ma non succede nulla. Tutta la pressione sembra salire nella tua testa, e alla fine senti uno schiocco umido e una pioggia di icore di mammifero troppo caldo sulle tue antenne. 

Ti svegli in una pozza del tuo stesso sangue sotto la testa, una pozza che puoi vedere nonostante guardi dritto in alto. Ci vorrà del tempo prima che i cristalli dei tuoi occhi si induriscano adeguatamente, ma già i colori sono ancora più ricchi di prima e il mondo sembra in qualche modo lento.
